title: Campus Placement Records, Top Recruiters, and Salary Statistics
content: For the graduating academic batch, over 150 multinational companies visited the campus, making 650+ placement job offers. Highest salary package offered was Rs 42.5 LPA by a leading product firm, with an average salary package of Rs 7.8 LPA across branches. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Amazon, Microsoft, L&T, Accenture, and Barclays.
